Article 9 — Notification thresholds (Legislative Decree No. 1034, as amended)

Economic concentration operations must be notified to INDECOPI when the gross income in Peru of all participating agents in the preceding fiscal year exceeds 5,000 UIT and at least two participating agents each have gross income in Peru exceeding 1,000 UIT.

The UIT (Unidad Impositiva Tributaria) is revised annually by Supreme Decree.
